html:
If you are looking for a one day retreat in Bali that offers deep healing, emotional release, and spiritual connection, Bali Bliss Wellness invites you into a truly meaningful experience.

Introducing our One Day Immersion Retreat in Ubud, a private and personalized journey designed to help you reconnect with yourself through authentic Balinese healing traditions.

Held every Friday, this retreat is ideal for those who seek transformation but may not have the time for a longer retreat.

What Is a One Day Immersion Retreat?

Our One Day Immersion Retreat is a carefully curated healing experience that combines ancient Balinese rituals with modern energy healing practices.

Within just one day, you will be guided through a powerful process of:

  • Energy cleansing and purification (Melukat ritual in Bali)
  • Balinese healing techniques
  • Reiki and intuitive energy work
  • Sound healing with Tibetan singing bowls

This is not a group tour, but a private retreat in Bali, allowing you to receive full attention and a deeply personal experience.

Choose Your Personalized Healing Journey

At Bali Bliss, we understand that each person’s path is unique. That’s why we offer five different retreat experiences:

1. Purification & Blessing

A traditional Balinese water purification ritual (Melukat) to release negative energy and invite clarity and protection.

2. Sacred Birthday Blessing Ceremony

A special spiritual birthday ritual in Bali to awaken your natural energy, reconnect with your life purpose, and set intentions for your new cycle.

3. Sacred Healing & Purification Ritual

Combining Balinese healing with purification to support emotional release and energetic balance.

4. Sacred Renewal Immersion

A holistic experience blending water purification and Reiki healing for a full reset of body, mind, and spirit.

5. Sound & Soul Healing Immersion

A calming journey using sound healing in Bali with Tibetan singing bowls, combined with purification to restore inner harmony.

Who Is This Retreat For?

This healing retreat in Ubud is ideal for:

  • Individuals experiencing stress, emotional heaviness, or burnout
  • Those going through life transitions or seeking clarity
  • Travelers looking for an authentic spiritual experience in Bali
  • Anyone called to reconnect with their inner self in a sacred environment

Whether you are new to healing or already on your spiritual path, this retreat meets you where you are.

Why Choose Bali Bliss Wellness in Ubud?

Located in the heart of Ubud, Bali Bliss Wellness offers a peaceful and nurturing environment surrounded by nature.

What makes our retreat unique:

  • Private and personalized sessions
  • Integration of authentic Balinese rituals
  • A balance of traditional and intuitive healing approaches
  • A safe, grounded, and supportive space

Our intention is not only to provide a service, but to hold a space where real transformation can happen.

Book Your One Day Retreat in Bali

Your healing journey does not have to wait.

Our One Day Immersion Retreat in Bali is available every Friday with limited availability to ensure a high-quality experience.

You are in the right place.
